newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates to start daily Manchester, Jo'burg flight.
newsitem.headline: Emirates to start daily Manchester, Jo'burg flight.

text.p: Dubai government-owned Emirates airline (EK) said it would start daily flights to Manchester on June 1 and to Johannesburg on July 1. Both services will be operated on Airbus aircraft.
Manchester will get two more flights a week. Johannesburg will get three more flights, it said in a statement.
Of the seven weekly EK Johannesburg flights, five are direct and are operated on a code-share basis with South African Airways (SAA). Two go via the Comoros Islands.
SAA, which has two services a week between Dubai and Johannesburg, will operate one on a code-share basis with EK.
Together, the airlines offer nine flights a week on the sector, six of which are code share. --Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
